I am writing in response to the deduction notice received regarding my tenancy at Noida @bhk. I dispute several proposed deductions from my security deposit of ₹50,000.

The deduction of ₹18,000 for wall repainting is disputed as the lease specifies normal wear and tear is not chargeable, and no evidence of damage beyond this or an invoice has been provided. The deep cleaning charge of ₹6,500 is disputed because the lease only permits this if the premises are unusually unhygienic, and no supporting evidence or invoice has been provided. The charge of ₹1,800 for a broken wardrobe hinge is disputed due to a lack of evidence confirming the damage or an invoice for repair. The deduction of ₹1,000 for missing keys is disputed as no evidence confirms the keys are missing, nor has an invoice for replacement been provided. Finally, the floor polishing charge of ₹12,000 is disputed because the lease states ordinary flooring wear is not chargeable, and no evidence of damage beyond this or an invoice has been provided.

In total, I am disputing deductions amounting to ₹39,300. I request a revised refund breakdown or the full disputed amount of ₹39,300 to be returned to me within 7 days. If I do not receive a response within this timeframe, I will follow up in writing.

DepositBack helps organise evidence and draft communication. It does not provide legal representation and does not guarantee any outcome.
